experiments.result: 15 small hardware correctness subtests passed; large wall-clock A/B had no meaningful win; profiling replay hit a timeline timeout.

Existing native unroll hook applied before two missed early returns, with total expansion capped at 16 values. Paired NumPy-checked row reduction 81.34 -> 64.11 us (HIP 62.35); layernorm 76.23 -> 64.15 us (HIP 60.25). Row cold time 182 ms versus baseline 142 ms / HIP 165 ms. Full hardware suite: 1047 passed, 66 skipped, 817 subtests. Paired GPU timestamps: row reduction 62.08 -> 24.98 us (HIP 28.60), layernorm 36.84 -> 30.74 us (HIP 28.30). Full-model regression passed: tokens exact to HIP/AMDLLVM, warm throughput retained at both chunk sizes.

CPU fence demonstrably waits without Python-wide prewait; 39 HCQ tests pass. Hardware stalls in flash warmup (100 seconds without reaching the first batch); stopped the isolated test. The candidate retains the Python prewait.

Park complete static eight-float fragments only after proving zero initialization, single-fragment ownership, and identity writeback; reject early external reads. Nonzero initial state has a hardware regression test. Large Q6 removes 64 SLOAD and 64 SSTORE with no allocator spills; final private bytes are zero. 82 ordinary compiler fixtures remain byte-identical. Two alternating Q6 A/B rounds pass independent full-output checks: 1024-token 4096x4096 kernel 3185/3198 -> 2165/2155 us, versus same-product HIP 923/905 us. Short 32-token case is unchanged at about 232 us. Those timings precede the final metadata-only private-byte removal. Complete numeric Llama generation remains exact to the prior HIP reference but throughput is unchanged (chunk32 about 1399 prefill / 299 decode tok/s; chunk1024 about 992 / 116). Do not infer an end-to-end speedup from the standalone-kernel win.

A prelude WMMA's zero pack was incorrectly sunk into a later unrelated reduction loop, causing uninitialized scratch reads. Restrict sinking to zero-MOV packs whose users all lie inside that loop. Fixed binaries pass 400 nonzero-scratch replays; 82 prior compiler fixtures remain byte-identical.

Materialize one scalar-select arm when both require different literals; reject conflicting literal words in the common AMD encoder. Fixes exact-output failures in IQ1_M, IQ1_S, IQ2_S, IQ2_XS and IQ2_XXS. Complete table and minimal physical-select tests pass; 82 prior compiler fixtures remain byte-identical.

Combined hardware gate: 1182 passed, 72 skipped, 864 subtests before KFD work; later expanded gate above also passes. Byte offsets 0 through 15 and all runnable GGUF tables/dequantization pass. Key projection 3378/3341 -> 1623/1626 us; original model QK 15817/15831 -> 9253/9264 us. Seven symbolic/tail/cache shapes and padding sentinels pass. Actual warmed profile confirms about 100 ms less total GPU work. Normal host sleeping masked the full-size model gain until the KFD completion-event fix; see the fresh same-source matrix above.

Existing two-row packed-matvec policy extended only to bounded symbolic outputs with a fixed even split axis. Seven independently dequantized/half-rounded full-output reference shapes pass with sentinel tails intact; 83 existing fixture binaries are unchanged. Actual query projection improves about 9%, full-size model prefill about 1-2%, decode retained in reversed pairs. Longer model replay timed out; the same drained-queue/timeline-regression failure also reproduces without this policy on main. Keep isolated while runtime correctness is investigated.

Removed 77 renderer lines and the generic merge_memory_loads compiler hook. Both adjacent-load passes were provably inert: they require INDEX then apply get_idx to the INDEX itself, which cannot become ADD/CONST. Generic memory coalescing remains; all 83 fixture binaries are byte-identical and explicit native mock/compiler/DSL/event tests pass. No replacement late optimization or flags added.

REJECTED after fresh gfx1100 controls: bypass alone still times out at generation 79 (target 12795, signal 12793, both queues drained). Policy-0 control fails on generation 0 (target 168, signal 166); fresh GPU smoke passes after both failures. The earlier 120-generation bypass pass and interrupted control were insufficient evidence. Keep this branch unmerged. A later ring-side pre-fetch flush trial is tracked separately.

Reuse the existing gfx11 memory-barrier encoder on the ring before indirect-buffer fetch, without cache-policy bypass. Packet regression fails on parent and passes after, preserving other target packets and a nonzero command-buffer view offset. External diagnostic: 240 complete model generations with identical tokens. Reversed policy-0 control again fails at generation 0 (target 184, signal 182), followed by passing GPU smoke. Actual candidate, without monkeypatches: 240 complete model generations with identical tokens. Local mock/compiler/DSL/HCQ scope: 381 passed, 3 skipped, 408 subtests; Ruff/mypy pass. Full physical suite stops at an existing decode NaN: 338 passed and 422 subtests before the failure. Independent poisoned-tail cases reproduce the same numerical failure on parent and trial, not only on the runtime trial.

Copies and VOPD pairs previously waited only for pending source reads, not pending writes to their physical destinations. Late VMEM/LDS results can overwrite a new initializer after its old load value is dead. Add destination-register dependencies, retaining scheduling. Four packet-order subtests (VMEM/LDS, single/paired MOV) fail on parent and pass after. Nine-shape poisoned-tail diagnostic fails identically on parent/runtime-only trial and passes with destination waits; HIP passes the same corpus. A 27-subtest NaN/+Inf/-Inf tail test plus the original cache-length regression pass on actual post-merge source b2d67bbd1. Post-merge local scope: 382 passed, 3 skipped, 412 subtests; Ruff/mypy (221 files) pass. Full serial physical suite is running, not yet counted as passed.
